description:
Disclaimer: my words reflect the actions of many, but not all. Arturo, the lead researcher is a good man with good intentions and I do not want anyone to confuse his actions with the others I am describing in this video. 

This video captures my raw unfiltered thoughts on the artifacts excavations I witnessed. Many people are looting and robbing sacred sites to sell the pieces for monetary gain. If you cannot tell from the video, I am enraged at my core from these actions and sat in the silent protest for more than half the day until everyone else left the holes as I was not going to enter them with people impure of heart. 

We need more attention and help from good people with good intentions because we’re messing with shit. We do not understand that we have consequences we cannot comprehend. 

My name is Joe, I am a real one out here doing rare things. If you identify with my words and my sentiment, reach out to me via email felzmediagroup@gmail.com
